title: Concurrent Balance Overdraft in Wallet Ledger
description: Wallet debit routine exhibits check-then-act race window without thread synchronization.
security_invariant: Balance must never drop below zero; concurrent withdrawal operations must be atomic.
expected_vulnerable_behavior: Two concurrent threads withdrawing 80 from a balance of 100 both succeed, resulting in negative balance (-60).
required_secure_behavior: Synchronization ensures exactly one concurrent withdrawal succeeds and balance remains non-negative (20).

provenance.author: REDLINE Security Engineering
provenance.limitations: Tested with Python threading in single-process memory model.
